items.stem: A claims audit shows visits billed at a higher-complexity code than the documentation supports. What is the primary compliance concern?

options.text: Upcoding: billing a level not supported by documentation
options.rationale: Correct: billing a higher level than documentation supports is upcoding, a core billing-integrity violation.

options.text: Nothing, as long as the service was clinically appropriate
options.rationale: Clinical appropriateness does not justify billing an unsupported level.
The scenario is higher-than-supported coding, i.e., upcoding.
This is a billing-integrity issue, not primarily privacy.

items.explanation: Correct: billing a higher level than documentation supports is upcoding, a core billing-integrity violation.

items.stem: A laptop containing protected health information is lost. Before deciding whether to report, what should the compliance team do first?

options.text: Perform a breach-risk assessment to determine the probability that PHI was compromised
options.rationale: Correct: a risk assessment determines whether the incident is a reportable breach.

options.text: Immediately conclude it is not a breach because it was accidental
options.rationale: Intent does not resolve breach status; assessment is required.

options.text: Report to every patient without any assessment
options.rationale: Notification follows the assessment and its conclusions.

options.text: Delete the device remotely and record nothing
options.rationale: Failing to document and assess is itself non-compliant.

items.explanation: Correct: a risk assessment determines whether the incident is a reportable breach.

items.stem: A referral arrangement pays a physician above fair market value for patients sent to the hospital's imaging centre. Which TWO legal concepts are most directly implicated? (Select TWO)

options.text: Anti-kickback concerns over remuneration for referrals
options.rationale: Correct: paying for referrals implicates anti-kickback principles.

options.text: Physician self-referral (Stark-type) restrictions on financial relationships
options.rationale: Correct: a financial relationship affecting referrals implicates self-referral rules.
Trademark law is unrelated to the arrangement.
Export control is irrelevant to physician referrals.

items.explanation: Correct: paying for referrals implicates anti-kickback principles. Correct: a financial relationship affecting referrals implicates self-referral rules.
